# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
lang: python
file: CWE-434-safe.py
---
from flask import request
from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename

def upload():
    uploaded = request.files["document"]
    if allowed_file(uploaded.filename):
        uploaded.save("/srv/uploads/" + secure_filename(uploaded.filename))

def allowed_file(filename):
    return filename.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower() in {"pdf", "txt"}
